Fields.Name: Bullet Hit Decal - Surface Offset
Fields.Description: Metres. Decals from bullet hits are placed this far from the hit point along the surface normal, so they don't clip into the surface.

Fields.Name: Character Wet Decal Fade Range
Fields.Description: Metres. Fade width used when a character's wetness clears its decals (blood and similar); passed to the decal system by the character wetness update.
